exec.purpose: Ask Music and Spotify what is playing
allowedArgs: for app in Music Spotify; do /usr/bin/pgrep -xq "$app" || continue; out=$(/usr/bin/osascript -l JavaScript -e 'function run(argv){var a=Application(argv[0]);if(!a.running())return "";if(a.playerState()!=="playing")return "";var t=a.currentTrack();return JSON.stringify({state:"playing",app:argv[0],title:String(t.name()||""),artist:String(t.artist()||"")})}' "$app" 2>&1); case "$out" in *-1743*) printf '{"state":"denied","app":"%s"}\n' "$app"; exit 0;; '{'*) printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 0;; esac; done; echo '{"state":"idle"}'

ko.Ask Music and Spotify what is playing: Music과 Spotify에서 재생 중인 곡 확인
ko.Turn BarShelf on for ${sources.data.app}: 시스템 설정 ▸ 개인정보 보호 및 보안 ▸ 자동화에서 BarShelf의 ${sources.data.app} 항목을 켠 뒤 새로 고치세요.
